events.title: Exxon, Chevron warn fuel prices to endure as war knocks refining
events.summary: ExxonMobil and Chevron Corp. have warned that high fuel prices are likely to persist, even if crude oil prices fall, due to global refining capacity shortages caused by ongoing conflicts in Russia and the Middle East. Nearly 10% of the world's refining capability is offline, leading to record-high fuel-making margins for refiners but increased costs for consumers. This bottleneck is evident in rising gasoline and especially middle distillate prices, with little room for error in the highly utilized remaining refineries.

events.title: Nvidia partners with Apollo, BlackRock, and others on $500B AI financing push
events.summary: Nvidia is partnering with major financial institutions like Apollo, BlackRock, and others to create financing platforms aimed at raising over $500 billion for AI infrastructure. These agreements, structured as memorandums of understanding, will allow outside investors to fund data centers and other AI infrastructure without impacting Nvidia's balance sheet. Analysts view this move as a positive step, shifting the funding burden and reinforcing Nvidia's market leadership.

events.title: First Solar raised at Baird as Section 232 clears path for bookings
events.summary: Baird upgraded First Solar to Outperform from Neutral, raising its price target to $318. The upgrade follows a Section 232 tariff decision, which analysts believe removes a significant overhang and will clear the path for new bookings at higher average selling prices. This development is expected to catalyze bookings for 2029-2030 and simplify the investment narrative for First Solar, a leading utility-scale solar manufacturer.

events.title: Nvidia stock holds Overweight rating as Wells Fargo cites AI financing deal
events.summary: Wells Fargo maintained an Overweight rating on Nvidia stock with a $315 price target after Nvidia announced a major AI infrastructure financing partnership. The partnership, valued at over $500 billion with firms like Apollo and BlackRock, aims to finance AI compute infrastructure and positions Nvidia beyond a traditional supplier role. InvestingPro analysis suggests the stock is undervalued, and the company is helping create "AI Factories" with evolving recurring revenue potential.

events.title: Goldman Sachs Preferreds Strategy Update: Hold Rated (NYSE:GS.PR.A)
events.summary: This article analyzes Goldman Sachs' three preferred stocks, highlighting their similar floating rate formula with a floor rate. While Goldman Sachs demonstrates strong dividend and par value coverage, making default on preferred dividends unlikely, the author rates all three as "Holds" due to what they perceive as low yields compared to other preferred stock options. The strategy emphasizes that floating rates offer better protection during rising interest rates but are less advantageous when rates decline.

events.title: Nvidia Teams Up with Six Wall Street Giants to Build Compute Financing Platform, Aiming to Unlock Over $500 Billion in Capital for AI Infrastructure
events.summary: Nvidia has partnered with six major financial institutions, including BlackRock and Goldman Sachs, to create a compute financing platform aimed at mobilizing over $500 billion in capital for AI infrastructure buildouts. This initiative seeks to establish compute chips as an investable asset class, enabling customers to finance large-scale AI resources without straining their balance sheets. While the announcement led to a slight dip in Nvidia's stock and increased attention on its credit risk, CEO Jensen Huang addressed "circular financing" skepticism by emphasizing genuine demand and independent due diligence from partners.

events.title: Wyndham Hotels & Resorts (NYSE:WH) Price Target Cut to $80.00 by Analysts at Susquehanna

events.title: Nvidia's $500 Billion AI Plan Gets Wall Street Backing
events.summary: Nvidia is reportedly in discussions with major Wall Street firms, including Goldman Sachs and BlackRock, to finance the next phase of AI infrastructure development, potentially freeing up over $500 billion. The strategy involves treating AI data centers as revenue-generating infrastructure that can be financed with long-term assets. Nvidia may also underwrite up to 25% of qualifying loans to help clients access funding, addressing a potential bottleneck for demand for its chips.

events.title: Goldman's M&A Leadership Bodes Well: Should You Buy GS Stock Now?
events.summary: Goldman Sachs (GS) continues to lead in the global M&A market, particularly in South and Central America, driving strong investment banking revenues. The company's focus on AI transformation, strategic streamlining by exiting consumer banking, and robust liquidity position for capital distribution are expected to further boost its performance. Despite a premium valuation, analysts are bullish on GS, with strong earnings growth prospects and a "Strong Buy" Zacks Rank, making it a compelling option for medium- to long-term investors.

The investment highlights Apollo's growing focus on sports financing and the increasingly competitive sports investment market.

events.title: UBS Capital Decision Postponed by Swiss Parliament Committee

The delay impacts UBS, which could be required to hold an additional $20 billion in equity capital under the government's proposal.

events.title: Goldman Sachs Bets Again on Options ETFs With NEOS Deal

events.title: Goldman Sachs Announces Agreement to Acquire NEOS Investments

This acquisition will add $30 billion in active income ETFs to Goldman Sachs Asset Management's portfolio, positioning it as a top eight active ETF provider with $80 billion in active ETFs. The deal, expected to close in Q1 2027, aims to meet growing investor demand for active ETFs and derivative-based solutions.

events.title: JPMorgan, Goldman, Invesco Test Blockchain Across Wall Street
events.summary: JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Invesco, and Citadel Securities, along with nearly 40 other firms, conducted a four-hour test in July to assess the viability of tokenized assets on blockchain networks. Overseen by the DTCC, the exercise involved trading stocks and Treasuries, posting collateral, and meeting margin calls to replicate real-world market activities. The primary goal was to determine if these new technologies could operate efficiently while maintaining the security and control of traditional markets, with the DTCC planning for broader adoption by October.

events.title: Goldman Sachs Has Made a $2.25 Billion ETF Deal. Bitcoin And Ethereum Funds Come With It

events.title: Is the Goldman Sachs Gold ETF or the abrdn Silver ETF a Better Inflation Hedge?

events.title: IN-HOUSE ROUNDTABLE: Banking on the future
events.summary: This roundtable discussion features in-house counsel from major Asian banks—Bank of Singapore, Deutsche Bank AG, and UBS—addressing the complex challenges facing the banking industry, including geopolitical tensions, technological disruption, and divergent regulatory regimes. They discuss strategies for safeguarding institutional resilience, managing the integration of generative AI, strengthening financial crime compliance, and building future-ready legal teams.
